More recently, over the last two years both the Bulović and Bawendi groups have been a part of the formation and launch of the ADDEPT center (DE-EE0010503) led by Prof. Tonio Buonassisi. Within that center, we have had weekly discussion meetings with CubicPV and Verde Technologies since March 2023, as they are both industry participants in the center. In addition, we have close connections with Swift Solar and Active Surfaces perovskite solar companies that have been launched from the Bulović group, and they are aware of our technical advancements. Path forward for our technical advancements that were developed in the present program is through commercial adoption of our processes and techniques, as well as through additional research that will be carried out through ADDEPT. Project 1: Templated 2D perovskites formation on 3D perovskites We worked on a novel fabrication method to control the orientation of 2D perovskites on 3D perovskites. We found that the following factors contribute to affect the 2D perovskite formation: (1) Intermediate phases at the early stages of 3D perovskite crystallization which facilitate ion exchange to template the 2D perovskite growth.
